eps.ov: Tanya is put in charge of a combat team fighting on the Eastern front.
Tanya comes up with a plan to stop the attacks on her unit.
An ally comes up with a plan to end the war.
The Empire goes all-in on a plan to break the Federation army once and for all.
Zettour is reassigned to the eastern front after an argument with High Leadership.
Zettour uses himself as a decoy to lure out the enemy and save Tanya.
Tanya returns to the capital and sees what daily life is like there.
Tanya uses a new type of torpedo to save her allies in the south.
Tanya enjoys a wonderful day in Ildoa before returning to the Empire.
The Empire turns to diplomacy to end the war.
Time is running out for the empire, and both Rudersdorf and Zettour are willing to take drastic measures.
Tanya defends Rudersdorf's plane from an assassination attempt.
